app.name: WoW Roster
app.tagline: Roster management for World of Warcraft: Forever guilds

home.heroTitle: Your roster, always up to date
home.heroText: Sync your guild with Blizzard's armory, group mains and alts per player, and see the gear, talents and professions of your whole roster in one place.
home.loginDisabled: Sign-in is not configured: the Blizzard API credentials are missing.

roster.title: Roster
roster.text: Statuses from guild ranks, roles from specs, and officer overrides.

armory.title: Armory
armory.text: Gear, enchants, talents for both specs, stats, professions and reputations.

sheet.title: Audit sheet
sheet.text: Coming soon: configurable rules, weekly history and an optional Google Sheet.

home.noGuilds: You are not in any roster yet. Create a custom one, link your guild or ask for an invite.

guildRegister.title: Link a guild
guildRegister.help: Creates a roster synced with your in-game guild. You need a character with an officer rank.
guildRegister.name: Guild name

myCharacters.title: My characters
myCharacters.help: Star your main: your other characters will be listed as its alts.
myCharacters.empty: We found no characters on your Battle.net account.

roster.raiders: {count, plural, =0 {No raiders} one {# raider} other {# raiders}}
roster.confirmHide: Hide {name}? They keep syncing with the hidden status.
roster.name: Name
roster.linkHelp: Link this entry to the real character once it exists in the game
roster.planHelp: For characters that do not exist yet (e.g. your Forever roster before launch). Link them to the real character later.
roster.plannedNamePlaceholder: e.g. the name you plan to use
roster.plannedForYou: It will be added under your name.
roster.myAdded: Characters added; they will sync in a few seconds.
roster.addHelp: Any existing character in {region}, from this guild or another.
roster.noApiYet: This version has no public Blizzard API yet: for now the roster only holds planned characters. Once it is published you can link them to the real ones.
roster.proposeHelp: This roster is published. You can propose your characters or plan one: they stay pending until the owner accepts them.
roster.proposalSent: Proposal sent: the owner has to accept it.

settings.title: Guild settings
settings.syncIntervalHelp: At least {min} minutes. Shorter intervals use more API quota.
settings.minLevelHelp: Characters below this level are not synced.
settings.officerMaxRankHelp: Players with a character at this rank or above (0 = guild master) manage the guild.
settings.ranksHelp: Each in-game rank sets a default status. Officers can override it per character.
settings.noRanks: Ranks appear after the first sync.
settings.name: Name

character.noData: No armory data for this character yet.
character.unsupported: Not available in this game version.
character.unavailable: The Blizzard API did not return this data.
character.gems: {count, plural, =0 {no gems} one {# gem} other {# gems}}
character.professionsManualHelp: Blizzard's API has no professions for this game version: the character's owner enters them.
character.professionsNotSet: The owner has not entered their professions yet.

createRoster.title: Create a custom roster
createRoster.help: No guild needed: for cross-guild raids, groups of friends or planning Forever before launch. Invite people with a link.
createRoster.name: Roster name

composition.title: Composition
composition.raiders: {count, plural, =0 {No raiders} one {# raider} other {# raiders}}
composition.plannedProviders: {count, plural, one {# of them planned} other {# of them planned}}
composition.plannedFootnote: * Includes planned characters. Counts mains with a raiding status; the buff list is configured in the game profile.

members.title: Members and invites
members.help: Members see the roster and add their characters; officers manage it. In linked guilds, officers are also detected by rank.
members.inviteOnce: Copy the link now: for security it cannot be shown again.

invite.alreadyIn: You are already in this roster: open it
invite.expired: This invite has expired or has no uses left.
invite.loginFirst: Sign in with Battle.net to join.

versions.label: Game version
versions.title: Game version
versions.help: Sets the classes, specializations, buffs and the API real characters are read from.
versions.changeHelp: Planned specializations that do not exist in the new version are cleared; classes stay so you can pick again.
versions.lockedGuild: A roster linked to a guild uses the version the guild exists in.
versions.lockedCharacters: This roster has real characters, which belong to its version. Remove them before changing it.

pending.titleOwner: {count, plural, one {# pending request} other {# pending requests}}
pending.titleMine: {count, plural, one {Your pending proposal} other {Your # pending proposals}}
pending.helpOwner: Characters proposed by other users. They do not count in the roster or the composition until you accept them; accepting makes their author a member.
pending.helpMine: {count, plural, one {The roster owner has to accept it. Meanwhile you can withdraw it.} other {The roster owner has to accept them. Meanwhile you can withdraw them.}}

publish.title: Publishing
publish.help: A published roster appears in the published rosters list: any user signed in with Battle.net can see it and propose characters, which stay pending until you accept them.
publish.label: Publish this roster

published.title: Published rosters
published.help: Open them to see their composition and propose your characters; the owner decides whether to accept them.
published.empty: There are no published rosters yet.

deleteRoster.title: Delete roster
deleteRoster.help: Deletes the roster, its entries, members and invites. Characters are kept. This cannot be undone.
deleteRoster.helpGuild: Stops tracking the guild: deletes the roster, its ranks, entries, members and invites. Characters are kept. This cannot be undone.

details.title: Roster details
details.help: Every real character of the roster in tables. Only the tabs this game version's API provides are shown.
details.noApi: This game version has no Blizzard API yet: details will appear once it is published. Until then the roster only holds planned characters.
details.empty: This roster has no real characters yet.
details.missingReason: The API did not return this data ({reason})
details.gearLegend: Hover (or tap) an item to see its tooltip; ↗ opens it on Wowhead. ✦ enchanted · ◆ gems.
details.instanceLegend: Best difficulty with bosses killed: killed/total. Hover to see every difficulty.
details.noRaids: No character has raid progress recorded.
details.manualProfessions: This version's API has no professions: each character's owner enters them on its sheet.
details.mythicLegend: Each dungeon shows the season's best key (✓ timed; grey, over time), this week's keys (how many and the highest) and how many times it was cleared on Mythic overall, Mythic 0 and keys included. The week starts at the weekly reset.
details.reputationsLegend: Click a character to see all its reputations.

weekly.title: Weekly audit
weekly.help: What each character did in the game week (since the {region} weekly reset) and their history. Updated on every sync.
weekly.noApi: This game version has no Blizzard API yet: the audit will appear once it is published.
weekly.noWeeklyData: This game version's API gives no weekly data (raid bosses, dungeons or Mythic+), so there is nothing to audit yet.
weekly.empty: This roster has no real characters yet.
weekly.legend: Counts bosses and keys dated after the weekly reset. Hover a raid to see its bosses.
weekly.legendVault: Counts bosses and keys dated after the weekly reset. Vault: unlocked slots (raid by distinct bosses, dungeons by Mythic+ keys). Hover to see the bosses and thresholds.
weekly.historyLegend: One column per week since recording started. Weeks without a sync stay empty.
